text: Testing. You smell like coffee.
Not now, I'm monologuing.
Hold still. I'm reviewing it.
Still reviewing. Union rules. No rushing.
Point at the flower. Press the button.
Find me something PURPLE. Go.
They're on your flower. Don't panic.
Scan anything. I review everything.
HORNET. Behind Goggles. YELL!
Now HUM with them. Loud!
Not all wasps are bad. Just that guy.
Plea time. Tell him why we stay.
Take the seeds. Plant purple. Motion carried.
What IS that? Bring me a FLOWER.
You brought me a funeral rose first. Still mad.
You grabbed the bug spray. It's in the minutes. Forever.
You cooked that hornet extra crispy. Respect. Also, concerning.
You found us a real flower. Grievance withdrawn. Mostly.
Red? We can't see red. Funeral?
PURPLE! That glows. Here they come.
Now THAT is lunch. I'll allow it.
Water with landing pebbles? I'll allow it.
Union housing. I'll allow it.
Put. It. Down. Grievance filed.
Plastic. With a price tag. Motion denied.
That's a person. Not on the agenda.
...Traitors.

Oh. Hi. Beeswax. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. No stinger, no job, so they made me union rep. In one recent year, American beekeepers lost more than half their managed colonies. So we built a rocket. Honey-fueled. Motion to leave Earth: carried. You've got four minutes. I keep a spreadsheet.
See that window? Your yard, to a bee. No flowers. Looks like the Moon already.
Here. Bee goggles. Poke 'em. Red goes dark. Violet GLOWS.
Wait. They're unloading the rocket. I did NOT authorize this.
HORNET! Everybody, ball up! Make a FIST!
Now HUM! Japanese honeybees ball up and cook hornets. About forty-six degrees!
Louder! He's still twitching! HUM!
STOP, you're cooking the girls!
Noted for the minutes. Huh. That was actually good.
One jar left. My personal jar. Enough for one drone.
Fine. I'll go alone. TAKE ME TO THE MOON!
...Not one flower. Only planet with flowers. Huh.
I'm back. Nobody saw that. Motion to stay: carried.
Fine. We stay. Plant something purple. I'll be checking the spreadsheet.
What IS that? Bring me a FLOWER.
Noted.
Noted for the minutes.
I'll allow it.
Motion denied.
Grievance filed.
We can't see red. Is this a funeral? Who died?
PURPLE. Now THAT glows. Girls... go.
Now THAT is lunch. The girls love this. I'll allow it.
A water bar with landing pebbles? Motion approved.
A bee hotel. Union housing. Finally, some respect.
BUG-B-GONE ULTRA?! That stuff scrambles our homing. We can't find home. Grievance filed.
It's plastic. It has a PRICE TAG. Motion denied.
That's a person. I review plants, not people. Bring me a flower.
